description: Validates a page source against the JSON schema and semantic rules: unique ids, dangling event targets, children only on container types, missing field_name, top-level types, and form-data bindings (duplicate field_name within one form; dangling promoId / connectedSurvey / connectedForm / set_field_value targets). Before validating it applies deterministic layout corrections (off-canvas boxes moved on-canvas, elements below wrapped text moved down) and lists them in auto_fixed. Returns errors (structural problems that block saving) and warnings (visible layout defects such as overlapping text, off-canvas bounds, or empty bands).

page.description: The page source object { page:[...], settings:{} } OR a JSON string of it.

name: validate_page
